title: GEOTECHNICAL ENGINEERING II
description: Applies fundamental soil mechanics principles to analyses of slope stability, retaining structures, and foundation support.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CE 372, CEM 372 or FE 315.
A minimum grade of C is required in CE 372, CEM 372 and FE 315.
